name: texture
character: texture-led: colour, grain and slow movement are the subject; there is no tune and no kick, and that is not a defect

focus.label: a colour that moves: a grain bed, a pad or a slow pattern
focus.reason: the piece is made of surface, not of a line; a motif is optional and must not be judged as the subject

pattern.melody_notes.reason: there is no melodic line to judge

pattern.loop_short.reason: a texture repeats its own grain by design

pattern.flat_dynamics.reason: the level holds while the spectrum moves

masking.vs_melody.reason: no figure to unmask; the texture is the subject
